answer:
The upgrade‑friendly behaviour for HNSW indexes was introduced in **pgvector 0.6.0**.  
In the 0.6.0 changelog it is noted that the release includes upgrade notes for Postgres 12 and Docker, which cover carrying HNSW indexes across a major PostgreSQL upgrade without rebuilding them:

> “If upgrading with Postgres 12 or Docker, see [these notes](https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector#060).”  
> [pgvector/CHANGELOG.md (lines 102‑116)]
